systems.owner: Secrétaire permanent municipal or d'arrondissement du Code Rural, under the authority of the Maire or Sous-Préfet
systems.tiers: one in each commune or arrondissement: a graphic document of land rights and a file of individual cards, as instituted by the 1993 ordinance, with no electronic form stated

note: Rural code ordinance of 1993: it institutes land commissions, permanent secretariats and the Dossier rural land-rights register in each commune or arrondissement; a law, and it states nothing about a connection, ICT equipment or electronic system at a commune office.
